name: Format Phone Number
purpose: Validates and formats the phone number in the active field: sends the number and the Twilio format option to karbon_kontroller "_wip_Format Phone" when no Twilio account SID is configured, otherwise to "Phone Lookup"; on an error shows "The phone number appears to be invalid.", selects the field text and returns -2; on success writes the formatted PhoneNumber back to the active field and returns 1.
writes: by name: the active field Get(ActiveFieldTableName) & "::" & Get(ActiveFieldName) = formatted PhoneNumber from the result (Set Field By Name step 21, current record)
calls:
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/523 "_wip_Format Phone { Data }" (step 9) [other file: karbon_kontroller]
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/533 "Phone Lookup" (step 11) [other file: karbon_kontroller]
open_question: secret: step 8 only tests whether System::TwilioAccountSid#68 is empty (the Twilio credentials live in karbon_kontroller scripts 523/533, not set here). Step 22 (Set Field to UtilityContactMethod::Phone) is disabled. Which service "Phone Lookup" calls is in karbon_kontroller script 533; the international case is a #TODO (step 6). Script is in the Scripts menu (includeInMenu=True) and is meant to run as a field validate/save trigger.
